rows.reason: TypeError: run() got an unexpected keyword argument 'progress'
TypeError: run() got an unexpected keyword argument 'progress'

cause: Adapter passed progress=on_cycle to the public 4T runner, whose callback option is on_progress. Both RPM rows returned TypeError before the cancellation timer on the clean run.
resolution: Use on_progress at the application adapter call. Add strict-signature callback regression; rerun real cancellation before source/build acceptance.
prior_acceptance_limit: First loaded run cancelled before reaching the API and passed with zero points; it did not exercise the broken callback dispatch.
